      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em;
      color: rgba(92,139,255,.9); margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #22c55e; display: inline-block; }
    .grad { background: linear-gradient(108deg, #6bd5ff 0%, #5c8bff 42%, #8a70f6 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; }
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2);
      height: 52px; padding: 0 var(--space-6);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-size: var(--fs-body); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      white-space: nowrap; transition: transform .16s var(--ease-out), background .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
      cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    .btn:active { transform: scale(.97); }
    .btn--primary {
      background: var(--primary-600); color: #fff;
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 6px 18px rgba(2,65,227,.35);
    }
    [data-theme="dark"] .btn--primary {
      background: #0241e3; color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 6px 20px rgba(2,65,227,.3);
    }
    .btn--primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); }
    .btn--secondary {
      background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .btn--secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-elev-2); border-color: var(--navy-400); }
    [data-theme="dark"] .btn--secondary { background: var(--bg-elev-1); }
    .btn--ghost {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); color: #fff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    }
    .btn--ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
    .btn--sm { height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--space-5); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-size: var(--fs-small); }

    /* ── Pills ── */
    .pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2);
      height: 26px; padding: 0 var(--space-3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill); font-size: var(--fs-micro);
      font-weight: var(--fw-semibold); letter-spacing: .02em; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .pill--brand { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
    .pill--success { background: var(--success-soft); color: var(--success); }
    .pill--neutral { background: var(--bg-elev-3); color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; }

    /* ── Container & Sections ── */
    .container { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: clamp(20px,4vw,32px); }
    .section { padding-block: clamp(88px,10vw,136px); }
    .section-head { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto clamp(48px,6vw,72px); text-align: center; }
    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2);
      font-size: var(--fs-micro); font-weight: var(--fw-semibold);
      letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--primary); margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(34px,5vw,60px); font-weight: var(--fw-medium); line-height: var(--lh-tight);
      letter-spacing: -.025em; color: var(--text-primary); text-wrap: balance;
    }
    .section-sub {
      margin-top: var(--space-4); font-size: var(--fs-h4); line-height: var(--lh-normal);
      color: var(--text-tertiary); text-wrap: pretty;
    }
    .grad {
      background: var(--ai-grad); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
    }

    /* ── Hero ── */
    .hero {
      padding: 160px 0 100px; text-align: center;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(92,139,255,.10) 0%, transparent 70%),
        var(--bg-canvas);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .hero {
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(2,65,227,.05) 0%, transparent 70%),
        var(--canvas);
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(40px,6vw,72px); font-weight: 700; line-height: var(--lh-tight);
      letter-spacing: -.035em; margin-bottom: var(--space-6); color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .hero p {
      font-size: 18px; color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 580px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-8); line-height: var(--lh-normal);
    }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .hero-stats {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: clamp(24px,4vw,56px);
      margin-top: 72px; padding-top: 48px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border); flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .hero-stat { text-align: center; }
    .hero-stat .num { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -.02em; }
    .hero-stat .label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-top: 4px; }

    /* ── Lead Dialog (Applivery-style chatbot popup) ── */
    .lead-section {
      padding: 0 0 80px;
      background: var(--bg-canvas);
    }
    .lead-demo {
      max-width: 440px; margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .lead-dialog {
      background: #0b1227;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-dialog { background: #f8faff; border-color: var(--border); }
    .lead-header {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 20px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-header { border-bottom-color: var(--border); }
    .lead-orb {
      width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5c8bff 0%, #8a70f6 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .lead-orb svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    .lead-title-group { flex: 1; }
    .lead-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lead-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; color: #4ade80; margin-top: 1px; }
    .lead-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ade80; }
    .lead-close {
      width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); border: none; cursor: pointer;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); transition: background .15s, color .15s;
    }
    .lead-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); color: #fff; }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-close { background: var(--bg-elev-2); color: var(--text-muted); }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-close:hover { background: var(--bg-elev-3); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .lead-close svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
    .lead-tabs {
      display: flex; margin: 12px 20px 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-tabs { background: var(--bg-elev-2); }
    .lead-tab {
      flex: 1; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; text-align: center;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); border: none; background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer; transition: all .18s;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-tab { color: var(--text-tertiary); }
    .lead-tab.active { background: #0241e3; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(2,65,227,.4); }
    .lead-body { padding: 16px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-height: 140px; }
    .lead-msg { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .lead-msg-orb {
      width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5c8bff 0%, #8a70f6 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .lead-msg-orb svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }
    .lead-msg-bubble {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      border-radius: 12px; border-top-left-radius: 4px;
      padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-msg-bubble { background: var(--bg-elev-2); border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .lead-input-area { padding: 0 20px 16px; }
    .lead-input-wrap {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 12px;
      transition: border-color .2s, background .2s;
    }
    .lead-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: rgba(92,139,255,.5); background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-input-wrap { background: var(--bg); border-color: var(--border); }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: var(--primary); }
    .lead-input {
      flex: 1; background: none; border: none; outline: none;
      font-size: 14px; color: #fff; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .lead-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-input { color: var(--text-primary); }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .lead-send {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: #0241e3; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0; transition: background .15s, transform .15s;
    }
    .lead-send:hover { background: #0137c4; transform: scale(1.08); }
    .lead-send:active { transform: scale(.95); }
    .lead-send svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
    .lead-footer {
      padding: 0 20px 14px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-footer { color: var(--text-muted); }
    .lead-footer svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .lead-footer a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.55); text-decoration: underline; }
    [data-theme="light"] .lead-footer a { color: var(--primary); }

    /* ── Marquee ── */
    .marquee-wrap { overflow: hidden; padding: 20px 0; background: var(--bg-elev-2); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .marquee { display: flex; gap: 48px; animation: marquee 40s linear infinite; white-space: nowrap; }
    .marquee span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; }
    .marquee span em { font-style: normal; color: var(--primary); }
    @keyframes marquee { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }

    /* ── Logo Marquee (services/integrations) ── */
    .logo-marquee-wrap { overflow: hidden; padding: 16px 0; background: var(--bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    [data-theme="dark"] .logo-marquee-wrap { background: var(--bg-canvas); }
    .logo-marquee { display: flex; gap: 56px; animation: logo-marquee 60s linear infinite; white-space: nowrap; align-items: center; }
    .logo-marquee-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);
      opacity: .6; transition: opacity .2s, color .2s;
      text-decoration: none; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-marquee-item:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--text-primary); text-decoration: none; }
    .logo-marquee-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    @keyframes logo-marquee { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }

    /* ── Trusted ── */
    .trusted { padding: 20px 0; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .trusted p { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .logo-strip { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; opacity: .5; }
    .logo-strip span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -.01em; }

    /* ── Feature Cards — EXACT Applivery sizing ── */
    .feature-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
    .feature-grid.centered { justify-content: center; }
    .feature-grid.centered .feature-card { max-width: 380px; }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--bg-elev-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 28px;
      transition: border-color .15s var(--ease-out), transform .15s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .15s var(--ease-out);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    }
    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-strong);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }
    .feature-card > * { flex: 1; }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .feature-card h3 { font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .feature-card p { font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: var(--lh-normal); }
    .feature-card pre {
      background: var(--bg-canvas); border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 12px; overflow-x: auto;
      font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--text-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); line-height: 1.6; flex: none;
    }
    .feature-card code { font-family: var(--font-mono); }

    /* ── Glow Panel — Applivery exact ── */
    .glow-panel {
      --bb-border: conic-gradient(from var(--bb-angle), #1ed6ff 0deg, #5c8bff 120deg, #8a70f6 240deg, #1ed6ff 360deg);
      --gp-radius: var(--radius-3xl);
      position: relative; isolation: isolate;
      border-radius: var(--gp-radius);
      animation: bb-turn 3.5s linear infinite;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .glow-panel::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: -9px; z-index: 0;
      border-radius: calc(var(--gp-radius) + 9px);
      background: var(--bb-border);
      filter: blur(24px);
      opacity: .37;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .glow-panel::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background: var(--bg-elev-1);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .glow-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
    @property --bb-angle { syntax: "<angle>"; initial-value: 0deg; inherits: true; }
    @keyframes bb-turn { to { --bb-angle: 360deg; } }

    /* ── Reveal Animation ── */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px);
      transition: opacity .6s var(--ease-out), transform .6s var(--ease-out);
      transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
    }
    .reveal.is-visible { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

    /* ── Float Animation ── */
    @keyframes float-y { 0%,to{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-8px)} }
    .float { animation: float-y 4s ease-in-out infinite; }

    /* ── Pillars ── */
    .pillars { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
    .pillar {
      background: var(--bg-elev-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl); padding: 32px;
    }
    .pillar-num { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--bg-elev-3); line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .pillar h3 { font-size: var(--fs-h3); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .pillar p { font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: var(--lh-normal); }

    /* ── Integration Marquee Grid ── */
    .integration-marquee-wrap { overflow: hidden; padding: 4px 0; }
    .integration-marquee { display: flex; gap: 24px; animation: int-marquee 45s linear infinite; white-space: nowrap; }
    .integration-marquee-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      background: var(--bg-elev-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 8px 14px;
      flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 160px;
      transition: border-color .15s, transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .integration-marquee-item:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary); transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); text-decoration: none;
    }
    .integration-marquee-item .im-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .integration-marquee-item .im-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .integration-marquee-item .im-desc { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    @keyframes int-marquee { 0%{transform:translateX(0)} 100%{transform:translateX(-50%)} }

    /* ── Steps ── */
    .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; counter-reset: step; }
    .step {
      position: relative; padding: 28px; background: var(--bg-elev-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    }
    .step::before {
      counter-increment: step; content: counter(step);
      position: absolute; top: -14px; left: 24px;
      background: var(--ai-grad); color: #fff;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
    }
    .step h3 { font-size: var(--fs-h4); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .step p { font-size: var(--fs-small); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: var(--lh-normal); }

    /* ── Nav brand ── */
    .nav-brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -.01em; }
    .nav-brand-sub { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--primary); margin-left: 6px; }

    /* ── Footer brand ── */
    .footer-brand-sub { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--primary); margin-left: 6px; }

    /* ── Applivery-style SDLC Diagram ── */
    .sdlc-diagram {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14,22,48,.95) 0%, rgba(6,10,24,.98) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(92,139,255,.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-3xl);
      padding: clamp(24px,4vw,48px);
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .sdlc-diagram {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-elev-2) 0%, var(--bg-elev-1) 100%);
      border-color: var(--border);
    }
    .sdlc-diagram::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 50% 30%, rgba(92,139,255,.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .sdlc-diagram > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* Tabs */
    .sdlc-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .sdlc-tab {
      padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--bg-elev-1);
      color: var(--text-tertiary);
      cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s;
    }
    .sdlc-tab:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .sdlc-tab.active {
      background: var(--primary-soft);
      border-color: var(--primary);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    /* Prompt banner */
    .sdlc-prompt {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      background: rgba(245,158,11,.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.3);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 13px; color: #fbbf24;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
    }
    [data-theme="light"] .sdlc-prompt {
      background: rgba(245,158,11,.08);
      border-color: rgba(245,158,11,.2);
      color: #d97706;
    }

    /* Orchestrator */
    .sdlc-orchestrator { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .orch-node {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5c8bff 0%, #8a70f6 100%);
      border-radius: 100px;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(92,139,255,.3);
    }
    .orch-icon { font-size: 16px; }

    /* Agents grid */
    .sdlc-agents {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .agent-node { text-align: center; }
    .agent-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      margin: 0 auto 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      background: var(--bg-elev-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: grid; place-items: center;
      font-size: 22px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .agent-icon.verified { border-color: rgba(74,222,128,.4); background: rgba(74,222,128,.08); }
    .agent-check {
      position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px;
      width: 16px; height: 16px;
      background: #4ade80; border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 10px; color: #060a18;
      display: grid; place-items: center;
      font-weight: 700;
